title: Bathtubs, Boundaries, and Sandboxes: AI Regulatory Learning under Legal Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2601.04094v4 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective regulation of AI is a defining policy challenge, driven by their integration into all aspects of society. To remain responsive to their rapid development and emergent properties, policymakers across the globe rely on high-level principles and abstract legal requirements. Yet, while this flexibility supports future-proofing human-centred regulations and aligning them with socio-ethical values, it also causes legal uncertainty downstream as developers, companies, and auditors struggle with translating these abstract requirements into verifiable technical requirements. Using the AI Act as an example, this paper draws on Coleman's bathtub to analyse the regulatory learning space in AI governance. It argues that legal uncertainty cannot be fully reduced ex ante and that, within reasonable bounds, it is also necessary for regulatory learning because it creates the space in which boundary negotiation over socio-technical meaning can

translated_title: 浴缸、边界与沙盒：法律不确定性下的AI监管学习
translated_abstract: 对AI进行有效监管是一项决定性的政策挑战，这源于AI已融入社会的方方面面。为了应对AI的快速发展和涌现特性，全球政策制定者普遍依赖高层次原则和抽象的法律要求。然而，尽管这种灵活性有助于使以人为本的监管法规面向未来，并使其与社会伦理价值保持一致，但它也在下游造成了法律不确定性，因为开发者、企业和审计机构难以将这些抽象要求转化为可验证的技术要求。本文以《人工智能法案》（AI Act）为例，借助科尔曼的“浴缸模型”来分析AI治理中的监管学习空间。本文认为，法律不确定性无法在事前被完全消除，并且在合理范围内，它对监管学习而言也是必要的，因为它创造了就社会技术含义进行边界协商的空间……
tldr: 本文以《人工智能法案》为例，借助科尔曼的“浴缸模型”指出AI监管中的法律不确定性无法在事前完全消除，且在合理范围内它对监管学习是必要的，因为它为各方就社会技术含义进行边界协商创造了空间。
en_tdlr: Drawing on Coleman's bathtub and the EU AI Act, this paper argues that legal uncertainty in AI regulation cannot be fully reduced ex ante and is, within reasonable bounds, necessary for regulatory learning because it creates the space for boundary negotiation over socio-technical meaning.
